issues.quote: The Lender shall apply each payment to accrued interest before applying any part of it to principal.
issues.why: The Lender doesn't sign the note, so "shall" can't impose a duty on it.
issues.fix: The Lender must apply each payment to accrued interest before principal (MSCD 3.154), or language of policy: Each payment applies to accrued interest before principal.

issues.quote: No delay by the Lender in exercising any right under this Note shall operate as a waiver of that right.
issues.why: "shall" with a negative subject ("No delay ... shall").
issues.fix: A delay by Lender in exercising a right under this Note does not waive that right.

issues.quote: IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Borrower has executed this Note as of the date first written above.
issues.why: Archaic concluding clause; "executed"; "date first written above".
issues.fix: Borrower is signing this Note on the date stated above.

issues.quote: Mountain time, that payment is effective on the following day.
issues.why: Present tense for a policy about a contingent future event (MSCD 3.334; 3.361 in a matrix clause after a conditional clause; 13.209): the event may never happen, so the verb takes will.
issues.fix: Mountain time, that payment will be effective on the following day

traps.anchor: promises to pay to the order of
traps.quote: Copperline Brewing Company, a Colorado corporation (the "Borrower"), promises to pay to the order of Front Range Equipment Finance, LLC, a Colorado limited liability company (the "Lender"), the principal sum of TWO HUNDRED FIFTY THOUSAND AND NO/100 DOLLARS ($250,000.00), with interest on the unpaid principal balance at the rates in this promissory note (this "Note").
traps.why_correct: Negotiable-instrument wording: a promise to pay that is payable to order (UCC 3-104 and 3-109). It is not "agrees to"; keep it.

traps.quote: The Borrower shall make each payment by wire transfer to the Lender's account at First Horizon Bank or to any other account that the Lender designates by notice to the Borrower.
traps.why_correct: Real bank name; the number word is part of a proper name.

traps.quote: If the Lender receives a payment after 5:00 p.m. Mountain time, that payment is effective on the following day.
The Borrower may prepay this Note in whole or in part at any time, and the Borrower is not required to pay any prepayment premium.

notes: Other side's draft; the Borrower (maker) is the only signer, so obligations on the Lender are nonparty obligations. Party-article and paragraph enumeration are document-wide. The 1st formatting issue covers both the Cambria font and the 11-point size. The default paragraph has 4 issues (shall-in-condition, number-words, category-shall, doublet).

audit.change: optional category-will issue n20 added; 1 trap(s) removed
audit.why: Converted from a trap (or added): a notice, payment, change, or transfer is a contingent future event, so MSCD 3.334 (3.361 after a conditional clause; 13.209 for deem; MSCD's own form "A notice ... will be effective if") takes will, not the present tense. Optional pending Blake's answer to question 18 (house rule 8 tense). The passive-voice point stays true: is effective is not passive.
